data.narrative:
Neura Robotics, a Series C-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $1.4B to date, is evaluated against a comp universe of 9 private robotics firms and 1 public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ). The private peer set includes Exotec, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, Hadrian, and Agile Robots, spanning Series B through Series D funding stages.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement to the $1.4B raised baseline, implying $2.4B. Peer-median analysis across 7 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range of $1.0B to $2.0B. The peer set includes Exotec at $2.0B (Series D), Generalist AI at $2.0B (Series B), Bedrock Robotics at $1.8B (Series B), Dexterity at $1.6B (Series B), and Hadrian at $1.6B (Series D).

Triangulating these methods supports a valuation range of $1.4B (low) to $2.7B (high), with a median of $2.0B. The low end anchors to total capital raised; the high end reflects stage-progression upside. Key uncertainties include revenue scale and margin trajectory relative to peers, capital efficiency post-Series C, and market adoption timing for the company's robotics platform. The $600M spread underscores sensitivity to stage-specific risk and comparative operational maturity within the peer cohort.
